name: Invalid file uploads
expected: all 7 bad files rejected (400/413), valid CSV accepted (200)
observed: program.exe (MZ header) -> HTTP 400; text renamed to .xlsx -> HTTP 400; zip without workbook.xml as .xlsx -> HTTP 400; 3 MB CSV (over 2 MB limit) -> HTTP 413; binary data named .csv -> HTTP 400; double extension .csv.exe -> HTTP 400; empty file -> HTTP 400; valid CSV (control) -> HTTP 200

name: Unauthorized project access (another logged-in user, project id guessed)
expected: every request returns 404, no data leaked, Alice's data unchanged
observed: GET analysis=404; GET AI analysis=404; GET PDF report=404; GET Excel report=404; POST add item=404; PUT edit item=404; DELETE item=404; POST import=404; PUT project=404; DELETE project=404; leaked=False; alice_data_unchanged=True

name: No login, missing/forged CSRF token, tampered session cookie
expected: 401 without login; 403 without a valid CSRF token; 401 for a tampered cookie
observed: no login list=401, no login analysis=401, login without CSRF=403, forged CSRF=403, empty CSRF (logged in)=403, tampered cookie=401

name: SQL injection strings in login, username and item fields
expected: login refused (401), odd username refused (400), payload stored as plain text, tables still work
observed: login=401; register=400; add item=201; stored literally=True; app/database still working=True
